summary: Adds fleet-summary.sh, one line per worktree with branch and clean/dirty state, using the same dirty semantics as repo-state.sh.

files.summary: New tool: parses git worktree list --porcelain and prints one line per worktree.

annotations.summary: Uses git diff --quiet for a fast clean/dirty check, matching repo-state.sh semantics.
annotations.rationale: git diff --quiet is the cheapest way to answer clean vs dirty; untracked files are ignored so the check stays fast in large trees.
annotations.author: opencode

annotations.summary: Drops the sort pipeline for a simpler single command.
annotations.rationale: The sort was redundant; for-each-ref already returns branches in a stable order.
annotations.author: opencode
